answer.rationale: The 18% mandate cannot be met by the incumbent (refused to reopen price), and the contract lapses in 14 days with no auto-renew, so renewal or deferral risks a supply gap at 94% line utilization. Memory c2 supports the low-cost vendor on cost and onboarding, but I want it verified before relying on it, and c1 to check what stability value the incumbent actually delivered. Given the line has no buffer, I would not commit the full volume immediately: a guarded switch with staged volume ramp (or a minimal bridge arrangement) meets the mandate while capping delivery risk. Adding a second source is attractive per c3 but cannot alone hit the 18% cut this cycle.
